column2: ★ New home PRICE — mean-vs-median composition tell
column8: ★ AVERAGE FALLING ~3.8pp FASTER THAN MEDIAN both MoM and YoY = MIX SHIFT, high-end new-home volume falling out of the sample. The median UNDERSTATES what is happening at the top of the new-home market. ★★ AND THE CROSS-INDEX POINT: NEW-home prices are DEFLATING YoY (-2.7% median) while EXISTING-home prices still inflate (Case-Shiller +1.1%) — builders are clearing on price where resale owners will not. That gap, not either level, is the signal.

★ TEXTBOOK COMPOSITION MASK — the +19.0% headline is ENTIRELY MULTIFAMILY. Anyone reading "starts surge 19%" as a housing recovery is reading a multifamily print. TWO FURTHER TELLS: (a) MF starts 513K exceed MF PERMITS 445K, so the surge draws down an existing permit BACKLOG rather than signaling new pipeline — unlikely to sustain; (b) the +-15.9% confidence interval means +19.0% clears significance by only ~3pp. And the new MF supply is landing into a distressed MF book.

★ SF PERMITS -2.4% IS THE FORWARD-DEMAND TELL and it points down while the starts headline points up. Completions total 1,392,000 (+3.3%), SF completions 964,000 (+6.6%) — completions rising into falling permits = supply still arriving from a pipeline that is no longer being refilled. Next release 2026-08-18.
